ctaHeading: Ready for expert joinery in Altona?
aboutText: InstallX is Altona's specialist in architectural joinery, dedicated to crafting exceptional spaces with precision and care. Our team brings years of expertise to every project, serving both residential and commercial clients across Melbourne and Victoria. We focus on quality workmanship and reliable service to bring your vision to life.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of joinery services from custom cabinetry to full architectural installations. Our team combines skilled craftsmanship with efficient labour hire to deliver projects on time and to the highest standards.

services.title: Architectural Joinery
services.desc: Specialising in custom architectural joinery, we design and install precision woodwork for homes and businesses across Altona.

services.title: Custom Cabinetry
services.desc: From kitchen cabinets to storage units, our custom cabinetry is crafted with attention to detail and quality materials.

services.title: Kitchen Installations
services.desc: We provide complete kitchen installation services, including cabinetry, countertops, and fittings, for a seamless finish.

services.title: Built-in Wardrobes
services.desc: We design and install built-in wardrobes that optimise storage space, using high-quality materials and precise joinery techniques.

services.title: Commercial Joinery
services.desc: For commercial clients, we deliver robust joinery solutions for offices, shops, and public spaces, on time and within budget.

services.title: Labour Hire Services
services.desc: Our skilled labour hire team provides experienced joiners for your projects, ensuring efficient work and professional results.
